entities.name: Dairis Bertāns
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dairis Bertāns is a Latvian professional basketball player and the team captain for VEF Rīga of the Latvian League (LBL) and the Latvian–Estonian League. Bertāns also plays for the Latvia national basketball team. He is the older brother of Dāvis Bertāns. He is a 6-foot-4-inch (1.93 m), 200-pound (91 kg) shooting guard.
